title: Exactly what I was looking for
body:
The app is simple, intuitive, and efficient.

The clean design and the functional customizable tools are efficient and beautiful, makes me wanna use it and therefore makes me consistent, which is essential.

I was looking for an app that didn’t have 3029 features that would turn the use into a big complicated mess and that I wouldn’t use at all. 
I just wanted an alternative to my bullet journal trackers to keep up with my habits and have a general overview of them throughout the months. And it’s perfect for that. 

I super recommend it.

title: Amazing! But here’s some suggestions for improvement (premium user)
body:
I absolutely love the app! Out of tons of other habit tracking apps, i chose this one because i love the idea behind it, so simple and yet effective. As a premium user, theres a few features that are very common in other apps and i really wish was present in superhabit. They are: 1. include pictures in the notes. 2. Let us the change the time in which the day should change. My day *always* ends after midnight and every time i gotta click habit by habit to edit :/ I wish i could just set the day to turn 2am once and be able to click to do normally (like it’s possible to do on habitica). 
Edit: PLEASE LET US CHECK YESTERDAYS HABITS 😩

title: Mercenario
body:
A ideia é boa e o app é bem feito, mas você só consegue por duas atividades, mais que isso tem que pagar.
Me fala qual a produtividade em duas tarefas apenas?
